1.name: Arcane Infusion
1.description: Infuse your weapon with arcane energy, granting a chance to deal 5 (L1) to 30 (L60) Magic Damage on melee attacks and a lesser chance to apply Arcane Frailty. Arcane Frailty reduces the target's Magic Resistance by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60) for 15s. While active, reduces the Mana cost of Arcane Spear by 25%.

1.name: Arcane Spear I
1.description: Hurl a spear of arcane energy at your target, dealing 3 (L1) to 10 (L11) Magic Damage. Mana cost reduced by 25% while Arcane Infusion is active.

1.name: Infused Slash I
1.description: Slash your target with an infused blade, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 2 (L1) to 5 (L10) additional damage based on your current infusion. Shares cooldown with other Might abilities.

effects.damageType: additional based on your current infusion
effects.display: 2–5 additional based on your current infusion dmg (L1–L10)

1.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 2–5 additional based on your current infusion dmg (L1–L10)

1.name: Shoot
1.description: Shoots your target with a bow. (requires bow & arrows)

1.name: Throw
1.description: Throw a throwing weapon at your target. Requires throwing weapon.

2.name: Minor Spellshield
2.description: A magical shield encircles you, increasing your HP by 10, AC by 5, and Magic Resistance by 5.

3.name: Aura of the Arcane
3.description: Envelop your group in an arcane aura, increasing their Intelligence by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60) and Spell Damage dealt by 10%. This ability persists until canceled.
3.valuesSummary: +1–15 Intelligence (L1–L60) · 1–15% and Spell dealt by 10% dmg (L1–L60)

4.name: Telekinetic Infusion
4.description: Infuse your weapon with telekinetic energy, granting a chance to deal 5 (L1) to 30 (L60) Physical Damage on melee attacks and a lesser chance to activate Kinetic Siphon. Kinetic Siphon decreases the target's Movement Speed by 8% (L8) to 16% (L60) and Agility by 5 (L8) to 15 (L60) while increasing yours by the same amount for 1 minute. While this infusion is active, the Mana cost of Kinetic Ward is reduced by 25%.
4.valuesSummary: 5–30 Physical on melee attacks dmg (L1–L60) · +5–15 Agility (L8–L60)

5.name: Kinetic Ward I
5.description: Construct a kinetic ward, increasing your Armor Class by 10 and absorbing 25 damage received for 15 seconds. While Telekinetic Infusion is active, the Mana cost of this spell is reduced by 25%. This spell scales with your Intelligence.

6.name: Magic Protection
6.description: Wards your target from the arcane, increasing their Magic Resistance by 5.

7.name: Phase Strike
7.description: Instantly teleport behind your target, dealing 80% Weapon Ratio Damage, activating your current infusion effect, and removing all stun and immobilize effects. This ability can be used while stunned or immobilized.

8.name: Conduit
8.description: Conduct your current infusion, channeling it into a unique spell of the same type. Arcane Detonation: Deal 10 (L8) to 300 (L60) Magic Damage. Electric Arc: Deal 5 (L1) to 150 (L60) Electric Damage, stunning the target for 1.5 seconds before arcing to another target. Telekinetic Push: Blast your target with telekinetic force, knocking them back and immobilizing them for 5 seconds. Activating this ability places your current infusion on a long cooldown and all other infusions on a short one.

8.name: Dispel Magic
8.description: Dispel magic from your target, removing one harmful effect.

9.name: Electricity Protection
9.description: Wards your target from shock, increasing their Electricity Resistance by 5.

10.name: Electric Infusion
10.description: Infuse your weapon with electric energy, granting you a chance to deal 5(L1) to 30 (L60) Electric Damage on melee attacks and a lesser chance to stun foes for 0.1 seconds. While this infusion is active, the Mana cost of Discharge is reduced by 25%.

10.name: Discharge
10.description: Electrocute your target with a powerful discharge, dealing 8 (L10) to 24 (L21) Electric Damage. While Electric infusion is active, the mana cost of this spell is redced by 25%.

10.name: Infused Slash II
10.description: Slash your target with an infused blade, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L10) to 10 (L20) additional damage based on your current infusion. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

effects.damageType: additional based on your current infusion
effects.display: 5–10 additional based on your current infusion dmg (L10–L20)

10.valuesSummary: 100% weapon dmg · 5–10 additional based on your current infusion dmg (L10–L20)

14.name: Seclusion
14.description: Secludes your target, reducing your Threat against them by 100 (L1) to 100 (L40), immobilizing them, and teleporting yourself a short distance away. This spell has a chance to be removed by damage.

16.name: Sense Magic
16.description: Gives the eyes of your target a magical coating, granting them the ability to see magical effects when considering targets for 1 hour.

16.name: Spellshield
16.description: Enshroud yourself with a magical shield, increasing your maximum Health by 50, Armor Class by 15, and Magic Resistance by 15 for 1 hour.

18.name: Fire Protection
18.description: Ward yourself against heat, increasing your Fire Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

18.name: Implosion I
18.description: Create a crushing vacuum around your target, decreasing their Block, Dodge, and Parry by 5 for 60 seconds. When this spell expires, the vacuum implodes, dealing 50 Physical Damage to your target and those around it.
